text_block_list.text:
On New Year's Day, I went on the first 
shrine visit of the year with Calstone 
Light O.

I join the line to offer prayers at the 
shrine. With this crowd, it looks like 
it'll take over thirty minutes...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this way. The edge is the most 
open.
choice_data_list:
You're right. The line on the end is 
shorter.

You're right. The line on the end is 
shorter.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The divine blessings are the same no 
matter where you pray. Look over there at 
that sign.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"‘Please spread out side-by-side to pray.’ 
It's written in bold calligraphy. You can 
really tell how hard the staff have it."
choice_data_list: So that's why you're helping out.
So that's why you're helping out.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Not really. It's just because the edge is 
faster.
choice_data_list: Well yeah, I kind of had a feeling though!

text_block_list.text:
I've really gotten used to her 
personality, I found myself thinking with 
deep fondness...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
We've finished paying our respects at the 
shrine. Now, as for what's next—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I just drew a fortune slip earlier. It was 
'Modest Luck.'
choice_data_list: Since when...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It was right next to the offering box, so 
I grabbed it in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It says, "Wishes will come true with 
effort." So, I thought I'd get right to 
making an effort.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
My fortune wasn't great for health, love, 
or business. I'll have to find a way to 
fix that.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Which one would be best?
choice_data_list: Health! Let's eat something nutritious!

Romance... M-Maybe boosting charm... or 
something?

If we're talking business, shall we check 
out the trendy hot spots?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: What do you mean by "nutritious"?
choice_data_list: Hmm, for this time of year, maybe hot pot?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Hot pot? Understood, let's go.

Calstone Light O stopped by a convenience 
store and seems to have bought something.
choice_data_list: So what did you buy?
What did you buy?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hot pot. Microwaving is faster than 
actually cooking it.
choice_data_list:
For that hot pot, I'd like a few more 
vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
So all I need to do is add vegetables, 
correct?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Daikon, carrots, some kind of leafy 
greens. Adding these should be plenty.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: (Crunch! Munch, crunch crunch crunch)

No sooner had she said that than Calstone 
Light O took a bite straight into the 
freshly washed vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal. Now then, let's 
head back to the dorms and have some hot 
pot.
choice_data_list:
You should've put vegetables in the hot 
pot.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It is a hassle. The time performance is 
terrible. It all ends up in the same 
stomach anyway.

That's certainly true, but... wait, 
wouldn't that actually be better since it 
prevents excess sodium? I ended up 
convincing myself that it wasn't such a 
bad thing after all.

With the New Year's holiday over, we 
quickly resumed training. Since we just 
had a break, we won't push the workload 
too hard.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The fact that you put that as a question 
makes me anxious.
choice_data_list: F-First, let's do some field research.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone, that's rare for you. What's up, 
just standing there? Can't find the shop?"

Gold City, an Umamusume who also works as 
a model, called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing fieldwork to boost my luck in 
love.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: Sorry for confusing you! The truth is...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. Well, the idea of boosting your 
charm isn't bad."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
How do I seem to you normally, City? You 
should know, since we share the same 
classroom.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: How can I become even more charming?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, follow me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: These are nail stickers.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at this...! It's nothing but 
straightaways!!

The nail stickers Gold City chose featured 
a striped design.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Stick 'em on your nails and boom, instant 
nail art. Wanna try doing your nails too?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Count me in! Having straight lines painted 
on my nails will totally get me fired up!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Right? You're always so straightforward 
and true to yourself. It's almost 
blinding.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I think you're fine just the way you are, 
though. Since you said you wanted to boost 
your charm, take a buff item.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If you don't know how to do it, bring it 
to the classroom. I'll do it for you.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Please do. Getting my nails 
done feels kind of thrilling and exciting. 
I can't wait.

With the New Year's holiday over, we 
quickly resumed training. Since we just 
had a break, we won't push the workload 
too hard.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
So we're going to learn from businesses 
that are booming lately. I see. Where 
shall we go?
choice_data_list: Let's go to an escape room!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yo, if it ain't Right O. Whatcha up to?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I am about to take part in this escape 
room game together with my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh, an escape room! Sounds fun! Hey, let 
me join in too.
choice_data_list:
I don't mind. With the three of us, we 
should be able to escape quickly.

I don't mind. With the three of us, we 
should be able to escape quickly.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
! There's a clear time ranking...! 
Everyone, let's aim for the fastest time!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Solve the picture shiritori cipher to 
open the door"? Damn it, a puzzle? I'm so 
bad at brainy stuff!

The first obstacle requires entering an 
8-digit password. Deciphering the code 
will reveal the numbers. It looks like the 
code is a picture shiritori, but...
choice_data_list:
There were a few paintings on the way 
here, weren't there?

There were a few paintings on the way 
here, weren't there?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! The picture of the gorilla and 
the glasses! There were numbers 
underneath... Ah, that's what it meant!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The picture for the question is 'Apple, 
3'. Next is gorilla, and after that should 
be a picture starting with 'la'.
choice_data_list:
Let's go check the number on the gorilla 
picture!

text_block_list.text:
And so, three of the eight digits were 
deciphered, but—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"This is taking way too long! Going back 
and forth along the same path over and 
over is totally inefficient!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I will carry you on my back and 
run a lap around the area. Please memorize 
the pictures and numbers.
choice_data_list:
In that case, wouldn't the two with better 
dynamic visual acuity be better...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't underestimate our memory! 
There's no way we could remember all that.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Please hold on tight. Haaah!
choice_data_list: W-Wait, hold on, waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
First obstacle cleared! Next up is... Oh, 
the whole wall is covered with 3-digit 
numbers. Are there like, 200 of them?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What's this? "Press 10 prime numbers 
within the time limit."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd know! Let's just mash the buttons 
for now!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. It'll be faster if we press all of 
them!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Alright, successful escape!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, I couldn't beat the 1st place time, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"There were questions that made us use our 
heads, yeah. Well, we just powered through 
'em our way, though!"

Calstone Light O and the others cleared 
the escape room using their own unique 
brand of brute force.

With the New Year's holiday over, we 
quickly resumed training. Since we just 
had a break, we won't push the workload 
too hard.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Finished 3 sets of wave running.
choice_data_list: Let's check your fatigue level.

text_block_list.text:
While giving instructions, I check the 
recorded video to make sure there are no 
anomalies in her form or stride.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: *chug chug chug chug*... Pwah!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It hasn't turned red. Fatigue does 
not seem to be an issue.

The drink showed no warnings, but... the 
video footage caught my attention. 
Compared to summer, her pitch was just a 
fraction slower.
choice_data_list: (It might be accumulated fatigue...)

text_block_list.text:
Strenuous training had continued since 
autumn. The lingering fatigue might have 
been piling up.

It seems best to avoid high-intensity 
training for a while. We also need to get 
her back to her previous running form for 
the upcoming race.
choice_data_list: Next up is tempo running.
Next up is tempo running!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: A tempo run? Not on the uphill slope?
choice_data_list:
Let's start putting on the finishing 
touches for the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I see. Understood.

Calstone Light O isn't very dexterous. It 
might be best to keep her fatigue under 
wraps.

Focusing solely on reaching top speed 
should allow for a much more relaxed run.
